Definition: properly, to stroke or rub; by implication, to erase; also to smooth (as if with oil), i.e. grease or make fat; also to touch, i.e. reach to
BiblicalUsage: 1) to wipe, wipe out; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to wipe; 1a2) to blot out, obliterate; 1a3) to blot out, exterminate; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be wiped out; 1b2) to be blotted out; 1b3) to be exterminated; 1c) (Hiphil) to blot out (from memory); 2) (Qal) to strike; 3) (Pual) full of marrow (participle)
